keyPoints.descZh: 回答 No（他不是五年前才开始画画）

q1.explanationZh: 第三段说他多年来一直利用业余时间画画，失业前就在画了，所以不是五年前才开始，回答 No。

evidence.quote: I had been drawing in my spare time for years

q2.sampleAnswer: He feels like a new man.

keyPoints.descZh: 画完后感觉像变了一个新人
examples: He feels like a new man.

q2.rubricZh: 要点：感觉像换了一个人（焕然一新）。
q2.explanationZh: 第四段直接写了：When I’m done, I feel like a new man.，照着原句回答即可。

evidence.quote: When I’m done, I feel like a new man.

q3.sampleAnswer: He has been selling prints of his work all over the world and landed a three-book deal with an art-book publisher.

keyPoints.descZh: 向世界各地的人卖他作品的印刷品
examples: sells prints of his work all over the world

keyPoints.descZh: 拿到了和艺术书出版商的三本书合同
examples: landed a three-book deal with an art-book publisher

q3.rubricZh: 要点：①向世界各地卖画作印刷品；②和艺术书出版社签下三本书的合约。答出两点。
q3.explanationZh: 最后一段说他现在把作品印刷品卖到世界各地，还和出版社签了三本书的合同，这就是他的成就。

evidence.quote: Now I’m selling prints of my work to people all over the world.

q4.sampleAnswer: A hobby is usually something we are good at. When we feel upset, spending some time with our hobbies can help us regain confidence and lift ourselves out of the darkness. (Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 从作者经历得出的好处（如：在低谷时让人平静、走出黑暗、带来成就）
examples: A hobby can help us feel calm and get through hard times.

keyPoints.descZh: 爱好可能带来的其他好处（如：增强自信、放松心情、结交朋友）
examples: A hobby can help us regain confidence.

q4.rubricZh: 开放题，言之有理即可：①结合作者经历说出爱好的好处；②再补充一个其他好处。
q4.explanationZh: 这是开放题。作者靠画画走过低谷、变得平静，还有了新成就。你还可以写爱好能让人放松、更自信。

evidence.quote: I found that even drawing ordinary things, like a pair of shoes, could help me feel calm.
